becomeascout.title: Become a member
becomeascout.subtitle: OF OUR ADVENTURE GROUP OF FRIENDS
becomeascout.description: In Scouterna you will find both challenges and new friends, no matter where you live or how old you are. Here you can experience adventures in nature, discover new ways to solve problems or just have fun together while we explore the world. And of course you are involved in deciding what we will come up with.

becomealeader.title: Become a leader
becomealeader.subtitle: IN SCOUTING TROUPE WITH POWER
becomealeader.description: As an adult, there are excellent opportunities to develop as a leader with us. You don't have to be an experienced sailor to participate in our activities. You don't have to be an old scout to become a leader either. The only requirement is that you have a genuine interest in working with young people and that you are interested in working voluntarily in a well-functioning scout corps. The corps pays for the training you need to function well as a scout leader.

aboutus.title: About us
aboutus.descriptionOne: Hässelby Strands Sjöscoutkår (HSS) is a traditional non-profit youth organization with a focus on scouting and boating. We are religiously and politically independent, and a member of the Swedish Scout Association, which with approximately 65,000 members is one of Sweden's largest youth organizations.
aboutus.descriptionTwo: The goal of our activities is to give children and young people the opportunity to experience nature, boating, seamanship, challenges and - above all - camaraderie. The basic idea is Learning by doing. There is no substitute bench in the scouts!
aboutus.descriptionThree: The Scout Corps was formed in 1959 and operates in a pleasant premises (called Ruffen) on the shores of Lake Mälaren in Hässelby. The Corps has around 130 happy members, owns five sailboats, ten optimist dinghies, two 2-krona boats, a fast escort boat and a large scout cabin.

sjohumlor.title: Sjöhumlor -
sjohumlor.subtitle: Spårare 8-9 years
sjohumlor.description: At the age of 8 you can start in HSS, i.e. when you start in grade 2. You then become a Scout Scout and a member of the Sjöhumlorna department. (Previously Scout Scout was called "mini scout") We have meetings every week and overnight stays, both hikes and longer camps

kaparna.title: Karpana -
kaparna.subtitle: Upptäckare 10-11 years
kaparna.description: At Kaparna, you start at the age of 10 and stay for two years until it's time for the next step. (Previously, scout scouts were called "junior scouts") At Kaparna, the difficulty of the tasks increases.

konvojen.title: Konvojen -
konvojen.subtitle: Äventyrare 12-14 years
konvojen.description: At the age of 12, the doors to the Adventure Scouts open. For three exciting years, you get to learn useful things in seamanship and nature. (Previously, Adventure Scouts were called "Patrol Scouts")

utmanare.title: Utmanare -
utmanare.subtitle: 15+ years
utmanare.description: HSS challenger scout team never ceases to exist! After your time as challenger scout, you are a close-knit group. It is not unusual for you to stay in touch for life. (Previously, this department was called "senior scout")
